justifications.type_expressiveness: RomanError is a clean enum with distinguishing variants, though the (value, &str) tuple table could be a small typed struct.
justifications.error_handling: Typed error enum with meaningful variants, no panics or unwraps, and the canonical re-encoding check ensures invalid forms are rejected.
justifications.api_ergonomics: Sensible derives and Display are present, but no doc comments on any public item (functions, error type, or variants).
justifications.idiomaticity: Uses matches!, strip_prefix, and iterator-style table lookup idiomatically, but the round-trip canonical check is a slightly redundant idiom rather than tight parsing logic.
